entities.summary: Jai Opetaia is an Australian professional boxer. He is a two-time International Boxing Federation (IBF) cruiserweight champion, having previously held the title between 2022 to 2026. He has also held the Ring magazine title since 2022. As an amateur, he won a bronze medal at the 2012 Youth World Championships and represented Australia at the 2012 Olympics and 2014 Commonwealth Games.
